description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Utils' providing static helper methods for Android SMS-related functionalities, such as checking Android OS version compatibility and managing default SMS app settings.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for SMS and Android version checks, as well as managing the default SMS app settings.

methods.name: hasJellyBeanMR2
methods.description: Checks if the device runs Android 4.3 (Jelly Bean MR2) or higher.

methods.name: hasKitKat
methods.description: Checks if the device runs Android 4.4 (KitKat) or higher.

methods.name: isDefaultSmsApp
methods.description: Determines if the application is the default SMS app based on system version and package name.

methods.name: setDefaultSmsApp
methods.description: Triggers an intent to prompt the user to set the app as the default SMS application on KitKat and above.
